instruction: Query Loki for log streams count
Get all distinct values for a label
Export Loki metrics to Prometheus format
Query top log producers by volume
Check log ingress rate to Loki
Create alert rule for high error rate
output:
cat > /etc/loki/rules/alert.yaml << 'EOF'
groups:
- name: error-rate-alert
  rules:
  - alert: HighErrorRate
    expr: sum(rate({job="nginx"} |= "error" [5m])) / sum(rate({job="nginx"}[5m])) > 0.05
    for: 5m
    annotations:
      summary: High error rate detected on nginx
EOF

instruction: Create recording rule for error ratio
output:
cat > /etc/loki/rules/recording.yaml << 'EOF'
groups:
- name: recording-rules
  rules:
  - record: job:nginx:error_ratio:5m
    expr: sum(rate({job="nginx"} |= "error" [5m])) / sum(rate({job="nginx"}[5m]))
EOF
kill -HUP $(cat /var/run/loki/loki.pid 2>/dev/null || systemctl show -p MainPID loki | cut -d= -f2)

cat >> /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
index_gateway:
  mode: simple
  replicas: 2
EOF

cat > /etc/loki/config.yml << 'EOF'
queryrange:
  parallelise_shardable_queries: true
  cache_results: true
EOF
wget -O - http://localhost:3100/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No web UI available'
